messages:
maria: Kicking off handoff for satellite-region 'edge-1' provisioning. Posting final boot/validation checklist and known issues we hit during the dry run. Please ack and take ownership of any bullets you own. Links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-1 and PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/462 :handshake:

akshay: ack. I'll own GPU fleet validation and cost calc notes. Quick question — did we pin the quantized model pool to the smaller memory profile?

maria: yes, quantized pool is using instance type g4dn.xlarge-equivalent (8GB GPU mem target). There's a fallback label for highmem-gpu. See step 3 in the runbook.

jonah: noted. I'll cover networking checks (MTU, path MTU discovery, cross-az routing) and the transient egress policy.

sasha: I'll take autoscaler + node labels and the canary traffic routing for Redwood runtime. Also adding a short troubleshooting FAQ for NV driver mismatch.

maria: condensed checklist (do these in order):
1) infra bootstrap: terraform apply (edge-1) var-file edge-1.tfvars
2) base images: ensure kernel+docker match image tag 'rbase-2026-02'
3) GPU pool: label nodes with "gpu=quant" or "gpu=highmem"; taint with "dedicated=redwood:NoSchedule"
4) network: verify MTU 9000 on calico interfaces and check path MTU to our storage endpoints
5) drivers: nvidia driver 535.x + cuda 12.2 required (see driver matrix in runbook)
6) autoscaler: set maxNodes=150, scaleDownDelay=20m, and enable warm-pool
7) observability: enable per-pod token cost annotations and trace sampling=1% for first 24h
8) traffic: canary 1% for 30m then 10% for 2h; rollback policy -> immediate fallback to model-legacy if latency > 150ms p95

maria: quick validation commands to run after nodes join (paste into monitor session):
```
# list GPU nodes\kubectl get nodes -l gpu -o wide
# check driver and cuda visible devices on node 'edge-gpu-03'\kubectl debug node/edge-gpu-03 -it --image=registry.internal/busybox:latest -- bash -c "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv"
# check pod-level token cost annotation on runtime pods\kubectl get pods -n redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.annotations.cost_token}\n'
```

akshay: adding a short known-issues list I hit during dry-run to the thread so it's easy for oncall: 
- Issue A: MTU mismatch between host and CNI -> intermittent packet drops. Workaround: set host MTU to 9000 and restart calico/node.
- Issue B: Old GPU driver (527.x) on image causes kernel oops under multi-process workloads. Workaround: rolling reimage, coord with build-team to update golden image.
- Issue C: Spot reclaim patterns caused scale glitches; set evictionGracePeriod=5m and enable node-protection for model-serving pods.
- Issue D: Egress costs spike when cross-region fallbacks trigger; enable cost-tagging and set routing policy to prefer local model variants first.

jonah: adding debugging tips for network flakiness: run pathmtu and traceroute for storage endpoints, and check iptables conntrack stats:
```
tracepath storage.s3.internal
ss -s | grep ESTAB
watch -n1 'sudo conntrack -L | wc -l'
```
If conntrack grows fast, reduce service affinity and enable keepalive tuning (net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max) and adjust kube-proxy mode to ipvs.

sasha: autoscaler gotcha — the cluster-autoscaler we run will ignore nodes with taints unless --balance-similarly flag is set. Also, when using warm pools, remember to set the imagePullPolicy to IfNotPresent to avoid delays on node start. I'll add an explicit snippet in the runbook.

maria: small cost note from finance: projected incremental monthly GPU cost for edge-1 at expected baseline 120 qps steady is ~ $48k/month (includes reserved instances for 60% of capacity, burst on-demand for 40%). Akshay, please verify numbers in the spreadsheet.

akshay: will do. One addition: we should add a cheap smoke evaluator job that runs 100 inference calls per hour to measure token/latency regressions early. Push as a cronjob in redwood-monitoring.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline edge-1: infrastructure plan applied for env=edge-1 by @maria. Plan ID: plan-2026-11-03-78a9.

maria: @deploy-bot thanks. Final handoff actions: 1) oncall run the short validation commands in first 30m, 2) if MTU issues see akshay/jonah, 3) if driver OOMs start reimage play and escalate to infra-ml. I'll be available for first 90m for immediate triage.

jonah: ack. I'll leave a short troubleshooting checklist near the incident runbook: "edge-1-networking" with quick commands and expected thresholds.

sasha: acked. I'll update the runbook with the autoscaler flags and known-workarounds section.

akshay: ack. I'll validate cost spreadsheet and add the smoke-eval cronjob.

maria: thanks all. Closing thread once PR merges and runbook link is updated in the console. :rocket:
